artifact_delivered: DQN sample efficiency study — 50-100 episodes optimal per WF window, HMM generalizes better than MA with more training
workstream_summary: C539: Built bin/dqn_sample_efficiency.py — episodes-per-window sweep (30/50/100/200) across 4 assets. Found 50 episodes is TSLA sweet spot (MA+HMM both beat B&H 3/3). HMM at 200 episodes +6.2pp vs MA -8.7pp — HMM benefits from more training, MA overfits. NVDA/SPY/AAPL never beat B&H at any episode count. DQN architecture (64 hidden) is likely the real bottleneck, not episode count.
